resources.string: Name, description, genre, year and developer in ES-DE and Pegasus
Fill in your launcher\'s game info: description, genre, year and developer

Dogmatix+ looks up the games on your device (your RomM server first, then the game databases) and writes what your launcher shows: name, description, genre, release year, developer and rating. Only empty fields are filled in. Whatever you or your scraper wrote is never changed, removed or reordered.
This changes your launcher\'s own files

ES-DE\'s gamelist.xml and Pegasus\' metadata.txt are edited in place. The first time a file is touched, a copy is kept next to it as gamelist.xml.dogmatix-bak or metadata.txt.dogmatix-bak. Close ES-DE first: it writes its own gamelists when it exits and would undo this.
One gamelist.xml per console folder, in the ES-DE folder you chose in Settings.
Choose the ES-DE folder in Settings first.
The ES-DE folder can no longer be written to. Choose it again in Settings.
A metadata.txt next to the games. Pegasus has to scan that folder already.
Write a game\'s details right after it has been downloaded. Off by default.
